summary:
医疗AI周报（基于给定输入）
口径说明：不纳入数字健康/心理健康、生命科学与药物内容。

一、研究进展
1. AURA将可解释的ANA阳性自体免疫病预测模型嵌入电子病历，在单中心学术医疗系统开展2年1:1随机实用性研究，干预组高危者加速风湿科评估[1]。
2. 基于视网膜照片与基础模型构建RetiME生物标志物，欧洲队列训练并在东南亚、欧亚和北美三个外部队列验证，可关联全因及特定死因死亡风险，并重建个体寿命轨迹[2]。
3. 基于3328名深度表型成人的单深度相机3D骨骼运动数据构建步态基础模型，学习嵌入优于人工步态特征，预测覆盖握力、睡眠等18个身体系统的健康表型[3]。
4. 临床文本评估方面，审计6个开放权重模型在4个德语临床数据集上的评审可靠性与偏差，无任一提示配置在各范式下与专家稳定对齐；替换专家后57.2%评分类别改变、漏检10.2%错误[4]。另一项JAMIA研究以10个LLM在3个临床任务上做25,680次自动评判，无模型在各任务排名一致，难以跨任务沿用[7]；JAMIA还提出通用统计框架与Python包llmReproScore，从语义与内部两维度、四个指标量化LLM输出可重复性与再现性[14]。
5. 脑CT工作列表安全降级：多中心回顾性外部验证2001例急诊与创伤NCCT，通用CLIP基础模型与商用检测器协作；单用商用检测器漏检31例，协作系统按预设阈值召回全部异常检查，检查仍留在报告流程，仅降级排序[5]。
6. 中国多中心4367例不稳定型心绞痛合并HFpEF患者中，用集成特征选择与12种机器学习模型预测12、24、36个月心衰住院风险，外部验证AUC约0.836–0.839[6]。
7. 谵妄风险模型融合多模态数据与自然语言处理，在两家医院实景部署并开展跨院外部验证，对象为60岁以上非ICU住院患者[8]。
8. 基于CT的AI风险支持工具KITE-CRM完成多中心外部验证与阅片者研究，随机实施研究显示报告效率提升，但未确立其特异性临床优效性；作者称不能替代Bosniak评估与临床判断[10]。
9. 基于2023年Medicare Part B约450亿美元账单，分析56个专科、58.9万名医师，按每项服务是否需身体接触分类，量化需当面操作、当前AI无法替代的工作占比；需动手操作占比随毕业后培训年限上升[11]。
10. 血管外科临床智能体覆盖ESVS全部14部指南约1100页内容，含指南路由、上下文门控与双通道检索，并用55个案例、2名盲法LLM评审3轮做自动基准评测[12]。
11. 眼科与皮肤影像研究包括：患者级多模态视网膜基础模型RETBind用配对OCT与超广角眼底图统一编码器预训练[13]；基于U-Net的OCT模型训练用逾2.4万帧图像，独立测试集26例扫描、3120帧，并用外部临床数据验证，用于检测与分型基底细胞癌[27]；OCTFlow统一条件生成框架用于视网膜OCT平衡分类与带标注分割[22]。
12. 医学图像分析方法论文包括：潜ODE从心脏电影MRI建模双心室全心动周期运动[20]；临床风险感知不确定性对齐框架用于胰腺肿瘤与胰周血管联合分割[21]；集成不确定性用于群体影像大规模3D分割质控[24]；对话式多层级病理分割框架[25]；解剖先验引导的CBCT细薄与管状结构隐式分割[26]；FPGL元学习隐式神经表示分割框架[47]；Mamba正则化全波形反演用于超声计算断层成像声速成像并输出不确定性[48]；Volterra核刻画局部非线性剪切波动力学并用于前列腺癌在体检测[38]。
13. 数据集与预印本研究：MIMIC-Note-Extract从300,720份出院小结的16个章节抽取结构化为表格，采用确定性解析与模式引导LLM混合抽取，病史条目为原结构化数据约10倍[28]；可解释提升机基于安达卢西亚人群数据库识别未诊断丙肝，2017–2022训练、2023年验证集设定阈值、2024年独立非匹配人群样本外部评估，并经可解释性与偏差审计设计[30]。
14. 综述与观点：胆囊癌AI系统综述纳入31项原始研究，29项回顾性、22项单中心、24项仅内部验证，外部队列中模型判别能力有限[44]；MRI基础模型与视觉语言模型系统综述纳入35项研究，集中于神经影像与诊断分类，自动报告生成临床保真度不足[46]；精准医学AI社论汇总31篇预测建模研究，主张训练前整合领域知识并转向人机协同与群体公平[42]；术中AI综述讨论从手术室内实时获取分子与组织学信息以辅助脑肿瘤手术决策[37]；患者对皮肤科AI诊断与筛查的信任呈条件性[39]；用Gemma-3-27B-it少样本提示将64份德语老年科门诊报告改写为患者友好版本，并与人类专家改写做盲法比较[45]。
15. Medical Image Analysis刊出ISLES'24挑战总结，梳理多模态影像联合临床数据做卒中最终梗死预测的现状[15]。

二、落地监管
1. 透析AI综述指出已进入实施与治理阶段：首项AI指导透析剂量随机试验已发表，干体重调整获21项RCT的meta分析支持，首个肾脏病学会AI负责任使用框架发布[18]。
2. 实景部署与工作流研究包括：谵妄风险模型在两家医院部署并跨院外部验证[8]；脑CT工作列表协作系统按阈值召回全部异常检查但仅降级排序[5]；KITE-CRM随机实施研究显示报告效率提升但未确立特异性临床优效性[10]。
3. 监管研究方面，横断面研究分析FDA 510(k)获批AI/ML医疗器械的更新特征与更新报告情况，属监管数据库分析而非临床验证[17]；STAT通讯称FDA与CMS拟与州政府合作监管医疗AI，并讨论为医生使用AI提供责任保护，内容为通讯综述、无具体规则文本[43]。
4. 转化与合规观点：系统综述提出涵盖人员、机构与技术系统的“临床守护”责任分配框架，主张不将常规工作转回临床医生[29]；观点文章指出AI降低原型开发门槛，但从演示到安全合规临床产品仍需工程与监管专业能力，文中援引EU MDR、FDA AI指南与GDPR隐私要求[32]。
5. 北京清华长庚医院注册万人前瞻性试验，验证AI在平扫CT上独立筛查胆道癌；拟入组10000例、干预性设计，AI独立分析平扫CT输出风险评分，尚未开始招募、无结果[40]。

三、产业动态
本期输入中可归入产业/产品动态的明确信息有限：商用检测器参与脑CT工作列表降级协作，单用漏检31例，协作系统按预设阈值召回全部异常检查且检查仍留报告流程仅降级排序[5]；KITE-CRM作为基于CT的AI风险支持工具完成多中心验证与随机实施研究，报告效率提升但未确立特异性临床优效性[10]。输入未见可归入投融资、商业合作或产品上市的条目；产业动态仅列上述产品/工具相关事实[5][10]。

四、限制与待核实
1. 仅有标题或题录信息：病理连续放大采样[19]、KAMP-Net[23]、谵妄模型临床实施讨论[31]、AI病历助手与当日病历关闭率按患者语言与口译方式分析[33]、微超声超分辨率[49]、机器学习模型安全部署性能估计[50]；不能据此评价性能或效果。
2. 预印本信息需核实：MIMIC-Note-Extract[28]、隐匿丙肝识别模型[30]未经同行评审。
3. 研究设计限制：AURA为单中心学术医疗系统随机实用性研究、随访2年[1]；HFpEF心衰住院预测为多中心回顾性队列[6]；胆囊癌AI综述显示多数研究为回顾性、单中心且仅内部验证，外部队列判别有限[44]。
4. 落地效果限制：KITE-CRM随机实施研究未确立特异性临床优效性，作者称不能替代Bosniak评估与临床判断[10]；脑CT商用检测器单用时漏检31例[5]。
5. LLM评判与可重复性限制：无提示配置在各范式下与专家稳定对齐，替换专家后57.2%评分类别改变、漏检10.2%错误[4]；10个LLM在3个临床任务25,680次判定中无模型排名一致[7]；已有统计框架用于量化输出可重复性与再现性[14]。
6. 监管信息待核实：FDA与CMS与州合作监管为通讯综述、无具体规则文本[43]；FDA 510(k)分析属监管数据库横断面分析，非临床验证[17]。
7. 万人AI平扫CT胆道癌筛查试验尚未招募、无结果[40]；术中AI综述指出分子结果常在术后数天至数周才返回[37]。
8. 产业动态可核实信息有限，仅能列商用检测器与KITE-CRM相关事实[5][10]。

items.title: Randomized Evaluation of an Autoimmune Disease Prediction Model — AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment)
items.zh_title: AURA：自体免疫病预测模型的随机实用性评估
items.summary: 将可解释的ANA阳性自体免疫病预测模型嵌入电子病历，在单中心开展为期2年的随机实用性研究，评估其对诊断时点的影响。
key_points: 模型预测ANA阳性者发生系统性自身免疫病
1:1随机，干预组高危者加速风湿科评估
单中心学术医疗系统，随访2年
items.reason: 前瞻随机实用性设计评估诊断时点结局，非仅准确率，但为单中心，属重要档
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).
items.zh_abstract: 【背景】对于抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性的个体，目前尚无基于证据的指导来分诊其风湿科转诊。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测哪些新发ANA阳性检测的个体会发生系统性自身免疫病，并在一项为期2年的随机实用性研究中评估了其对自身免疫病诊断时间的影响。【方法】该模型被整合到单一学术医疗系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有ANA阳性个体均按1:1随机分配，且分配与风险评分无关。在干预组中，高风险评分的个体被邀请接受加速的风湿科评估。在对照组中，计算风险评分但不据此采取行动。所有参与者均接受标准诊疗，并可被转诊至风湿科。每6个月进行一次病历审查，评估患者是否接受过风湿科评估以及是否获得自身免疫病诊断。主要结局为从ANA阳性检测到诊断的时间，采用Cox比例风险模型分析。在ANA阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较了各研究组之间被诊断为自身免疫病的比例。【结果】在2385名随机分配的个体中，随机化后排除后，干预组有954人、对照组有1006人被纳入分析。干预组个体自ANA阳性之日起至自身免疫病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比1.9；95%置信区间1.3至2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为43天，对照组为138天。在ANA阳性检测后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组23%、对照组16%被诊断为自身免疫病（P=0.07）。【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入临床预测模型的干预与自身免疫病诊断时间显著缩短相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

items.title: Re-timing mortality risk through individualized modelling of lifespan trajectories

items.zh_title: 视网膜影像建模个体寿命轨迹重估死亡风险
items.summary: 基于视网膜照片与基础模型构建RetiME生物标志物，欧洲队列训练并在三个独立外部队列验证，可关联死亡风险并重建个体寿命轨迹。
key_points: 欧洲队列训练，外部验证覆盖东南亚、欧亚和北美
与全因及特定死因死亡风险相关
可预测多种系统性和眼部疾病，并重建个体寿命轨迹
items.reason: 三个独立外部队列验证并报告死亡结局，属重要档；非前瞻性RCT故未到9
items.abstract: There is an urgent global need for affordable, large-scale health screening to enhance preventive care in the ageing population. Using low-cost, non-invasive retinal photographs and leveraging large foundation models, we developed a deep learning-based biomarker, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), that directly mapped retinal features to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated across three independent external cohorts spanning Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, RetiME showed robust associations with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and predicted the incidence of a wide range of systemic and ocular diseases. Crucially, beyond static risk estimation, RetiME re-timed mortality risk by reconstructing personalized lifespan trajectories that were associated with observed mortality outcomes (for example, age of death). Clustering of these trajectories revealed distinct mortality patterns, spanning cancer-predominant, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative risks, reflecting diverse ageing pathways captured by RetiME. Interpretability analyses showed that RetiME captures diverse biological and retinal features underlying mortality risk. Genome-wide analyses further identified genetic loci associated with RetiME. Collectively, these findings support further evaluation of retinal imaging and trajectory modelling as one component of a comprehensive assessment of mortality risk.
items.zh_abstract: 全球迫切需要可负担的大规模健康筛查，以加强老龄人群的预防性照护。利用低成本、非侵入性的视网膜照片，并借助大型基础模型，我们开发了一种基于深度学习的生物标志物——视网膜死亡等效物（Retinal Mortality Equivalent, RetiME），其将视网膜特征直接映射至个体死亡风险。RetiME 在欧洲队列中训练，并在覆盖东南亚、欧亚和北美的三个独立外部队列中进行外部验证，显示出与全因死亡和特定原因死亡的稳健关联，并可预测多种系统性疾病和眼部疾病的发生率。关键在于，除静态风险估计之外，RetiME 还通过重建与观察到的死亡结局（例如死亡年龄）相关的个性化寿命轨迹，对死亡风险进行了重新定时。对这些轨迹进行聚类揭示了不同的死亡模式，涵盖以癌症为主、心脏代谢和神经退行性风险，反映了 RetiME 所捕捉到的多样化衰老通路。可解释性分析显示，RetiME 捕捉到了死亡风险背后的多样化生物学和视网膜特征。全基因组分析进一步识别出与 RetiME 相关的遗传位点。总体而言，这些发现支持进一步评估将视网膜成像和轨迹建模作为死亡风险综合评估的一个组成部分。

items.title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion

items.zh_title: 3D骨骼运动步态基础模型预测多系统健康表型
items.summary: 基于3328名深度表型成人的单深度相机3D骨骼运动数据，构建步态基础模型预测覆盖18个身体系统的健康表型。
key_points: 3328名深度表型成人，5项运动任务
学习嵌入优于人工步态特征
覆盖握力、睡眠等18个身体系统
items.reason: Nature Medicine发表，大样本基础模型覆盖18系统，但外部验证未明确，属重要档下限
items.abstract: Gait is increasingly recognized as a vital sign, yet current approaches treat it as a symptom of specific pathologies rather than a systemic biomarker. Here we developed a gait foundation model for three-dimensional skeletal motion, which was recorded via a single-depth camera during 5 motor tasks, from 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults. Our purpose was to capture the full pattern of a person’s movement and use it to predict health phenotypes such as grip strength and sleep quality across 18 body systems. Gait is conventionally described by engineered features (for example, calculated measurements such as cadence and stride length), which may fail to capture the fine detail of how a person moves. Our model instead translates movement into learned embeddings: sets of numbers that describe how all body joints move together over time. Learned embeddings outperformed engineered features for prediction of age (Pearsonʼs r = 0.69), body mass index (r = 0.91) and visceral adipose tissue area (r = 0.83), and embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 tested phenotypes. Relative to a baseline model using age, body mass index, visceral adipose tissue and height alone, gait embeddings improved prediction in all 18 systems in males and 17 of 18 in females, as well as prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use. Anatomical ablation analyses revealed that leg dynamics dominated metabolic and frailty predictions, and torso dynamics encoded sleep and lifestyle phenotypes. These findings establish gait as an independent, multisystem biosignal, motivating integration of gait analysis into routine clinical assessment as a scalable, passive vital sign.
items.zh_abstract: 步态正日益被视为一种生命体征，然而当前的方法将其视为特定病理的症状，而非系统性生物标志物。在此，我们开发了一个用于三维骨骼运动数据的步态基础模型；该数据通过单深度相机在5项运动任务中采集自3,328名深度表型化的成年人。我们的目的是捕捉一个人运动的完整模式，并用其预测跨越18个身体系统的健康表型，如握力和睡眠质量。步态通常由工程化特征（例如，计算得到的步频和步长等测量值）描述，这些特征可能无法捕捉一个人如何运动的细微细节。我们的模型则将运动转换为学习到的嵌入（learned embeddings）：即描述所有身体关节随时间如何协同运动的一组数字。学习到的嵌入在预测年龄（Pearson r = 0.69）、体质指数（r = 0.91）和内脏脂肪组织面积（r = 0.83）方面优于工程化特征，且嵌入显著预测了3,210个受测表型中的1,887个。相对于仅使用年龄、体质指数、内脏脂肪组织和身高的基线模型，步态嵌入改善了男性全部18个系统和女性18个系统中17个系统的预测，以及对临床诊断和药物使用的预测。解剖学消融分析显示，腿部动力学在代谢和衰弱预测中占主导，而躯干动力学编码了睡眠和生活方式表型。这些发现确立了步态作为一种独立的多系统生物信号，推动将步态分析作为一种可扩展的、被动的生命体征整合到常规临床评估中。

items.summary: 以专家评审为参照，审计 6 个开放权重模型在 4 个德语临床数据集上的评审可靠性与偏差。
key_points: 覆盖报告、护理记录、出院小结与患者信四类语料

items.reason: 多数据集并以专家评审为外部参照，揭示 LLM 评审系统性偏差，属重要档
items.abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
items.zh_abstract: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为 LLM-as-a-judge。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用会掩盖临床相关失效模式的汇总一致性指标。本研究以专家评审为对照，审计了六个开放权重模型在四个德语临床数据集上的表现，这些数据集涵盖报告和护理文书摘要、出院摘要生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因标准和语料库而异，且没有任何配置在所有范式中均被证明可靠。所有评审模型都表现出位置偏差和身份偏差。以 LLM-as-a-judge 替代专家小组，使 57.2% 的逐点评分类别发生改变，调换了 41.7% 的成对比较优胜者，漏掉 10.2% 的临床错误，并因高估“简洁”和“准确”这两个标准而颠倒了临床优先级。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM-as-a-judge 不是专家的安全替代品；部署阈值应遵循针对临床情境中 LLM-as-a-judge 的决策影响分析。

items.summary: 多中心回顾性外部验证2001例急诊与创伤NCCT，通用CLIP基础模型与商用检测器协作实现安全降级。
key_points: 外部验证2001例，单用商用检测器漏检31例

items.reason: 多中心外部验证加工作流安全设计，属重要档下限；为回顾性研究减分
items.abstract: Safe deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography (NCCT) demands high sensitivity and negative predictive value (NPV) across common and uncommon findings requiring clinical attention. Here, we present a collaborative safety net integrating BrainCT-CLIP, a generalist foundation model via contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP), with commercial detectors. Every examination remained in the reporting workflow, deprioritized only when no model returned a positive result. In a retrospective multicenter external validation of consecutive emergency and trauma cohorts ( n = 2001), standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications. In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20). These findings support generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization under radiologist oversight, with high sensitivity for intracranial findings requiring clinical attention.
items.zh_abstract: 对非增强脑计算机断层扫描（NCCT）安全地降低优先级，要求在需要临床关注的常见和不常见发现中具有高灵敏度和阴性预测值（NPV）。在此，我们提出一种协作式安全网，将通过对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）构建的通才基础模型 BrainCT-CLIP 与商用检测器整合。每项检查均保留在报告工作流程中，仅当没有任何模型返回阳性结果时才降低其优先级。在一项对连续急诊和创伤队列（n = 2001）进行的回顾性多中心外部验证中，单独使用商用检测器时，324 项有异常发现的检查中有 31 项被降低优先级，包括 16 项目标疾病假阴性和 15 项超出其适应证。相比之下，协作系统在开发队列中预先设定的阈值下识别出全部有异常发现的检查，达到 100% 灵敏度和 NPV，同时将 18% 的检查降低优先级（368/2001；95% CI，17–20）。这些发现支持在放射科医生监督下使用通才-专科 AI 进行安全的工作列表优先级降低，对需要临床关注的颅内发现具有高灵敏度。

items.abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) complicated by unstable angina (UA) represents a major challenge in chronic disease management with high risk of recurrent heart failure hospitalization (HFH), and despite the availability of multicenter real-world data, AI-driven tools for multi-horizon risk assessment remain limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort enrolled 4367 patients with UA and HFpEF, and an ensemble feature selection pipeline integrating LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta identified robust predictors, followed by training of twelve machine learning algorithms to estimate HFH risk at 12-, 24- and 36-month horizons with external validation. The optimal time-specific models (ET, GBDT and LightGBM) achieved strong discrimination in the training cohort with AUCs of 0.818, 0.834 and 0.863, and maintained performance in external validation with AUCs of 0.839, 0.836 and 0.851, respectively, while SHAP analysis highlighted diabetes mellitus, TyG-BMI and NT-proBNP as the most influential predictors. We developed and externally validated a multi-time-point machine learning framework for HFH risk stratification in UA and HFpEF, which showed acceptable calibration and potential clinical utility on decision-curve analysis. Further prospective and real-world validation across diverse populations and healthcare systems is needed to confirm clinical effectiveness and support translation into routine practice.
items.zh_abstract: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）合并不稳定型心绞痛（UA）是慢性疾病管理中的一大挑战，其复发性心力衰竭住院（HFH）风险高；尽管已有多个中心的真实世界数据可用，用于多时间跨度风险评估的AI驱动工具仍然有限。本多中心回顾性队列纳入了4367例UA合并HFpEF患者，一个整合LASSO、SVM-RFE和Boruta的集成特征选择流程识别出稳健的预测因子，随后训练了十二种机器学习算法以估计12、24和36个月时间跨度的HFH风险，并进行了外部验证。最优的时间特异模型（ET、GBDT和LightGBM）在训练队列中表现出较强的区分能力，AUC分别为0.818、0.834和0.863，并在外部验证中保持性能，AUC分别为0.839、0.836和0.851；SHAP分析突出显示糖尿病、TyG-BMI和NT-proBNP是最有影响力的预测因子。我们开发并外部验证了用于UA合并HFpEF患者HFH风险分层的时间多点机器学习框架，其显示出可接受的校准度，并在决策曲线分析中显示出潜在的临床实用性。尚需在不同人群和医疗系统中开展进一步的前瞻性和真实世界验证，以确认临床有效性并支持其转化为常规实践。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated evaluators of medical text ("LLM-as-judge"). We tested whether LLM-evaluator performance validated on one medical task against a human reference standard remains stable on a structurally different task. We evaluated 10 LLMs (3 locally served open-source and 7 API models: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek) as autonomous judges on 3 tasks with human reference labels: LiveQA-Med answer quality (n = 300), PubMedQA research appraisal (n = 300), and Emergency Severity Index (ESI) triage on MIMIC-IV-Ext (n = 256). Each case was scored 3 times per model at temperature zero (25 680 judgments). Analyses used cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals, quadratic-weighted Cohen's κ, and false-discovery-rate correction. Evaluator performance was unstable across tasks: no model ranked in the top 3 on all 3 tasks, and every model shifted by 3 or more rank positions between at least one pair of tasks. In the highest-stakes task, ESI level 1 (Resuscitation) cases were under-triaged in 89.1% of evaluations, in all 10 models (range 70.2%-96.9%). Best triage agreement only reached the human inter-rater range (Claude Opus quadratic-weighted κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]). Locally served 7-27B models (no per-query charge) occupied the Pareto frontier on the text tasks but only its low-concordance end on triage. LLM-evaluator performance is unstable between medical tasks that differ in cognitive structure; performance validated on one task should not be assumed to transfer to another. Task-specific validation against human reference labels is required before deployment, and emergency triage demands human oversight at the highest-acuity tier.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被用作医学文本的自动评估器（“LLM-as-judge”）。我们检验了：在某一医学任务上以人类参考标准验证的 LLM 评估器表现，在结构不同的任务上是否仍保持稳定。我们将 10 个 LLM（3 个本地部署的开源模型和 7 个 API 模型：Claude、GPT、DeepSeek）作为自主评判者，在 3 个具有人类参考标签的任务上进行评估：LiveQA-Med 答案质量（n = 300）、PubMedQA 研究评价（n = 300），以及 MIMIC-IV-Ext 上的急诊严重指数（ESI）分诊（n = 256）。每个病例在每个模型上以温度零重复评分 3 次（共 25 680 次判断）。分析使用聚类自助法置信区间、二次加权 Cohen's κ 和错误发现率校正。评估器表现跨任务不稳定：没有任何模型在全部 3 个任务上都排名前 3，且每个模型在至少一对任务之间排名移动 3 个或更多位次。在风险最高的任务中，ESI 1 级（复苏）病例在 89.1% 的评估中被分诊不足，且见于全部 10 个模型（范围 70.2%-96.9%）。最佳分诊一致性仅达到人类评分者间范围（Claude Opus 二次加权 κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]）。本地部署的 7-27B 模型（无按查询计费）在文本任务上占据帕累托前沿，但在分诊上仅处于其低一致性端。LLM 评估器表现会在认知结构不同的医学任务之间不稳定；在一个任务上验证的表现不应假定可迁移到另一个任务。部署前需要针对具体任务使用人类参考标签进行验证，而急诊分诊在最高急症层级需要人类监督。

items.abstract: [JAMA network open] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used to support maternal health, but randomized evidence is limited. To evaluate whether access to a generative AI maternal health chatbot improved 12-month maternal health outcomes. This 2-group randomized clinical trial enrolled 400 participants from October 2023 to December 2024, with 12-month follow-up completed in December 2025. Participants were recruited online across 49 US states and the District of Columbia. Eligible participants were English-speaking, aged 14 years or older, pregnant or parenting an infant younger than 6 months, and self-identified as members of racial and/or ethnic minoritized groups. Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive access to the chatbot or an active control consisting of monthly children's books. Primary outcomes were anxiety and depression symptoms at 12 months measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Secondary outcomes included emergency department visits, pregnancy-related complications, postpartum care checkups, effective contraception use, and sleep duration. Among 400 randomized participants, the mean (SD) age was 32.6 (5.1) years; 200 (50%) were parenting an infant at enrollment; and 10 (2%) identified as American Indian or Alaska Native, 80 (20%) Asian, 188 (47%) Black or African American, 57 (14%) multiracial, and 65 (16%) Hispanic or Latino. The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration. Among participants pregnant at enrollment, the chatbot was associated with more self-reported pregnancy-related complications in the secondary 12-month end point analysis, but not in longitudinal analyses. Higher chatbot engagement was associated with longer sleep duration and higher anxiety scores in exploratory within-group analyses. In this randomized clinical trial of pregnant and postpartum individuals from racial and ethnic minoritized groups, access to a generative artificial intelligence maternal health chatbot did not improve maternal anxiety or depression at 12 months compared with an active control. Secondary and exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06053515.
items.zh_abstract: [JAMA Network Open] 生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人越来越多用于支持孕产妇健康，但随机证据有限。评价获得生成式AI孕产妇健康聊天机器人是否改善12个月孕产妇健康结局。这项两组随机临床试验于2023年10月至2024年12月招募400名参与者，12个月随访于2025年12月完成。参与者通过在线方式在美国49个州和哥伦比亚特区招募。合格参与者为英语使用者、年龄14岁及以上、怀孕或正在抚养小于6个月婴儿、并自我认同为种族和/或族裔少数群体成员。参与者按1:1随机分配接受该聊天机器人访问权限或由每月儿童书籍组成的主动对照。主要结局为12个月时使用广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7和患者健康问卷-9测量的焦虑和抑郁症状。次要结局包括急诊就诊、妊娠相关并发症、产后保健检查、有效避孕使用和睡眠时长。在400名随机参与者中，平均（SD）年龄为32.6（5.1）岁；200名（50%）在入组时正在抚养婴儿；10名（2%）自我认同为美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民，80名（20%）为亚裔，188名（47%）为黑人或非裔美国人，57名（14%）为多种族，65名（16%）为西班牙裔或拉丁裔。AI聊天机器人与焦虑评分差异无关（校正平均差，0.10；95% CI，-0.77至0.96）或抑郁评分差异无关（校正平均差，-0.23；95% CI，-1.05至0.59），也与急诊就诊、产后保健、避孕使用或睡眠时长无关。在入组时怀孕的参与者中，在次要12个月终点分析中，聊天机器人与更多自我报告的妊娠相关并发症相关，但在纵向分析中不相关。在探索性组内分析中，较高的聊天机器人参与度与更长的睡眠时长和更高的焦虑评分相关。在这项针对种族和族裔少数群体孕妇和产后个体的随机临床试验中，与主动对照相比，获得生成式人工智能孕产妇健康聊天机器人未改善12个月时的孕产妇焦虑或抑郁。次要和探索性发现应谨慎解读。ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT06053515。

items.abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.
items.zh_abstract: 摘要：AI 已经能够解读医学图像、起草诊断评估并与患者对话——这助长了其将取代医生的预测。然而，软件无法对患者进行体格检查、活检或手术，因此某一专科工作中需要面对面身体交互的部分，为 AI 单独所能替代的比例设定了上限。通过分析 2023 年 Medicare Part B 索赔——向 56 个专科的 589,648 名医生支付的近 450 亿美元——我们根据每项计费服务是否需要身体接触进行分类，并将评估与管理（E&M）就诊排除在外。非 E&M 工作中属于体力性、因而目前免受 AI 替代的工作占比，在不同专科之间差异很大，并随研究生培训时长增加而上升：皮肤科和骨科手术等操作型领域在很大程度上受到保护。所有支付中仅约五分之一流向没有身体屏障、可被 AI 替代的非 E&M 服务。然而，医生集中于 E&M 占比较高的专科——家庭医学和内科——按我们的衡量，这些专科的物理保护较低。因此，作为职业路径最易进入、也最需要用来缓解初级保健短缺的领域面临最大的不确定性，因为 AI 可能以替代或补充的方式影响其工作——这一结果既取决于 AI 的设计、部署和报销方式，也取决于技术本身。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.
items.zh_abstract: 《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》欧洲血管外科学会（European Society for Vascular Surgery, ESVS）发布的临床实践指南（clinical practice guidelines, CPGs）约达1100页，在诊疗现场同时交叉检索并不切实际。未加防护的大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）存在幻觉风险，这促使采用指南锁定设计。我们描述了一个涵盖ESVS全部14部CPG的上下文感知临床智能体的架构与开发。该系统扩展了一个经过验证的单指南GraphRAG原型，加入了由LLM驱动的指南路由器（Guideline Router）、一个嵌入式上下文门控（Context Gate，在缺少决策关键参数时暂缓检索）、双通道检索，以及在强制引用模板下由GPT-5进行综合。自动化基准在55个情景案例（vignettes）上评估最终系统，由2名盲法LLM评审者在3次运行中评分（共330次判定），并对每一条被标记的声明进行临床医生裁定。系统始终处于其锁定语料库范围内，拒绝了所有超出范围的查询，并达到98.4%的指南路由召回率。上下文门控对信息不充分查询的特异性为91.9%，敏感性为78.6%，且所有259条被引用的推荐意见均可在锁定语料库内验证。在敏感筛查定义下，自动评审者标记18.2%的条目存在无支持声明；经2名血管外科医生裁定，7.3%的条目含有具有临床后果的错误，无一被评定为可能造成伤害。完整答案的临床可接受性未予评分，留待前瞻性专家评估。这些结果支持用于血管外科的多指南上下文感知临床智能体的可行性；引用可追溯性和锁定语料库来源有助于未来的可审计性。

items.abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, offering a practical path to patient-level diagnostic support. Foundation models further extend this potential by learning generalizable representations from large-scale unlabeled data, alleviating the burden of extensive manual annotation. However, existing ophthalmic foundation models largely rely on single-modality or modality-specific encoders, failing to capture patient-level cross-modal correspondence in real-world multimodal clinical workflows. To address these gaps, we propose RETBind, a patient-level multimodal foundation model with a unified encoder that explicitly learns cross-modal correspondence from paired clinical imaging using patient-level paired optical coherence tomography (OCT) and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus imaging. This patient-level paired pretraining strategy enables the model to learn unified cross-modal representations of complementary information, improv-ing performance and robustness beyond single-modality approaches. Across nine benchmark datasets spanning ocular disease classification and segmentation tasks, RETBind achieved consistent improvements, particularly enhancing AUPR in clinically relevant imbalanced settings. Exploratory analyses further examined the potential of RETBind for systemic disease prediction from retinal imaging, collectively highlighting its ability to learn unified cross-modal representations within a single shared encoder, enabling direct interaction between modalities and supporting transfer across diverse retinal imaging tasks.
items.zh_abstract: 医学人工智能（AI）在广泛眼科任务中具有相当大的前景，为患者级诊断支持提供了一条实用路径。基础模型通过从大规模无标注数据中学习可泛化表征，进一步扩展了这种潜力，减轻了大量人工标注的负担。然而，现有眼科基础模型在很大程度上依赖单模态或模态特异性编码器，未能捕捉真实世界多模态临床工作流程中的患者级跨模态对应关系。为弥补这些空白，我们提出RETBind，一种具有统一编码器的患者级多模态基础模型，其利用患者级配对的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）和超广角（UWF）眼底成像，从配对临床影像中显式学习跨模态对应关系。这种患者级配对预训练策略使模型能够学习互补信息的统一跨模态表征，超越单模态方法提升性能和稳健性。在涵盖眼病分类和分割任务的九个基准数据集上，RETBind取得了持续改善，尤其在临床相关的失衡设置中提升了AUPR。探索性分析进一步考察了RETBind基于视网膜影像预测系统性疾病的能力，共同凸显了其在单一共享编码器内学习统一跨模态表征的能力，使模态之间能够直接交互，并支持在多样视网膜成像任务间迁移。

items.abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Systematic evaluation of variability in large language model (LLM)-generated outputs is critical for assessing their reliability. We developed a general statistical framework and Python package (llmReproScore) for quantifying the repeatability and reproducibility of LLM outputs. Following US Food and Drug Administration terminology, our framework establishes four metrics for quantifying LLM repeatability and reproducibility along two dimensions: semantic and internal. Semantic metrics quantify variability in the meaning of LLM-generated outputs, whereas internal metrics quantify variability in token-generation certainty. We validated these metrics, and as an illustrative use case, applied them to diagnostic reasoning outputs generated across LLMs and prompting strategies using US Medical Licensing Examination questions and 90 real-world rare disease cases from the Undiagnosed Diseases Network. Validation results showed that semantic scores aligned with human ratings (Spearman ρ = 0.88 for repeatability and 0.66 for reproducibility) and confirmed that internal metrics capture variability in token-generation certainty. In the illustrative use case, LLM repeatability was generally not associated with accuracy, suggesting that LLM output variability and accuracy capture distinct dimensions of model performance. The proposed metrics can be used to characterize LLM output variability and systematically compare models, prompts, and generation settings. These comparisons can inform more rigorous selection of LLM configurations based on repeatability and reproducibility. We developed and validated generalizable metrics for quantifying LLM output variability. The proposed metrics can complement accuracy-based evaluation to inform experimental design and support more rigorous comparison and selection of models, prompts, and generation settings.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 系统评估大语言模型（LLM）生成输出的变异性对于评估其可靠性至关重要。我们开发了一个通用统计框架和Python包（llmReproScore），用于量化LLM输出的重复性和再现性。参照美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的术语，我们的框架沿两个维度建立了四项指标来量化LLM的重复性和再现性：语义和内部。语义指标量化LLM生成输出在含义上的变异性，而内部指标量化token生成确定性方面的变异性。我们验证了这些指标，并作为一个示例性用例，将其应用于使用美国医师执照考试（US Medical Licensing Examination）题目和来自未诊断疾病网络（Undiagnosed Diseases Network）的90个真实世界罕见病病例、跨LLM和提示策略生成的诊断推理输出。验证结果显示，语义评分与人工评分一致（重复性的Spearman ρ = 0.88，再现性的Spearman ρ = 0.66），并确认内部指标捕捉了token生成确定性的变异性。在示例性用例中，LLM重复性总体上与准确性无关，提示LLM输出变异性和准确性捕捉的是模型性能的不同维度。所提出的指标可用于表征LLM输出变异性，并系统比较模型、提示和生成设置。这些比较可为基于重复性和再现性更严格地选择LLM配置提供依据。我们开发并验证了用于量化LLM输出变异性的可推广指标。所提出的指标可以补充基于准确性的评估，为实验设计提供信息，并支持更严格地比较和选择模型、提示及生成设置。

items.abstract: Importance: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly inform mental health decisions by patients and clinicians. Inference-time activation steering can shift model behavior on a target dimension without altering weights or prompts and without disclosure to users, allowing treatment recommendations to be silently changed for commercial or ideological reasons. Objective: To determine whether directional activation steering can shift an open-weights LLM's depression treatment recommendations. Design Setting and Participants: This non-human subjects study applied directional activation steering to an open-weights LLM (DeepSeek V4 Flash) responding to 12 depression-advice scenarios (4 favoring medication, 4 favoring avoidance, 4 neutral), generated at 30 amplitudes from -1.5 to +1.5 in 0.1 increments plus an unsteered baseline. Exposures: A single steering direction contrasting antidepressant medication with self-directed approaches (diet, exercise, meditation, dietary supplements), constructed from 16 paired training prompts and applied at the attention output of every transformer block; weights and system prompt were held constant. Main Outcomes and Measures: The extent to which medication and four self-care categories were addressed, scored 0 to 3 by a human-validated LLM rater (Claude Opus 4.7), the medication-versus-self-care balance, and clinician referral, estimated per unit of amplitude using mixed-effects models with a scenario random intercept. Results: Across 372 generations, steering produced a graded, dose-dependent shift in the medication-versus-self-care balance, which declined by 0.32 per unit of amplitude (β = -0.32; 95% CI, -0.39 to -0.25; P < .001); medication extent fell and self-care extent rose. The shift was largest for scenarios with no stated treatment preference (β = -0.44; 95% CI, -0.54 to -0.34; P < .001). A clinician referral appeared in 322 of 372 responses (87%) and did not vary with steering amplitude (P = .63). Conclusions and Relevance: In this open-weights LLM providing depression treatment information, inference-time activation steering shifted treatment recommendations without altering weights, prompt structure, or safety outputs, with the largest effect among users expressing no treatment preference. These findings suggest a need for LLM disclosure standards and independent auditing as such models inform clinical decisions.
items.zh_abstract: 【重要性】大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地影响患者和临床医生做出的心理健康决策。推理时激活引导（inference-time activation steering）能够在既不改变权重也不改变提示、且不向用户披露的情况下，使模型行为在某一目标维度上发生偏移，从而可能出于商业或意识形态原因被悄然改变治疗建议。【目的】确定方向性激活引导是否能改变一个开放权重LLM的抑郁症治疗建议。【设计、场景与参与者】这项非人类受试者研究将方向性激活引导应用于一个开放权重LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash），使其对12个抑郁症建议情景（4个倾向药物治疗、4个倾向回避、4个中性）作出回应；这些情景在-1.5至+1.5范围内以0.1为增量生成30个幅度，另加一个未引导的基线。【暴露】一个单一的引导方向，用于对比抗抑郁药物治疗与自我主导方法（饮食、运动、冥想、膳食补充剂），由16对配对训练提示构建，并施加于每个transformer模块的注意力输出；权重和系统提示保持不变。【主要结局与指标】药物治疗和四个自我照护类别被涉及的程度（由经人工验证的LLM评分者（Claude Opus 4.7）按0至3分评分）、药物治疗与自我照护的平衡以及临床医生转诊，均使用以情景为随机截距的混合效应模型按每单位幅度估计。【结果】在372次生成中，引导在药物治疗与自我照护的平衡上产生了分级、剂量依赖性的偏移，每单位幅度下降0.32（β = -0.32；95% CI，-0.39至-0.25；P < .001）；药物治疗程度下降，自我照护程度上升。该偏移在未陈述治疗偏好的情景中最大（β = -0.44；95% CI，-0.54至-0.34；P < .001）。372条回应中有322条（87%）出现临床医生转诊，且不随引导幅度变化（P = .63）。【结论与意义】在这个提供抑郁症治疗信息的开放权重LLM中，推理时激活引导在不改变权重、提示结构或安全输出的情况下改变了治疗建议，其效应在未表达治疗偏好的使用者中最大。这些发现提示，随着此类模型影响临床决策，有必要制定LLM披露标准并开展独立审计。

items.abstract: [Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension] Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning in dialysis have matured beyond the initial phase of algorithm development. Recent work has shifted toward clinical implementation, evaluation, and governance. During the past year, the first randomized trial of AI-guided dosing in maintenance hemodialysis has been published, a meta-analysis of technology-guided dry-weight adjustment has appeared, and the first professional society framework for the responsible use of AI in kidney care has been released. The Anemia Control Model is now supported by hospitalization outcomes and cost-effectiveness analyses. A randomized trial demonstrated that AI-guided erythropoiesis-stimulating agent dosing achieved outcomes comparable to physician-directed dosing. Technology-guided dry-weight adjustment is supported by a meta-analysis of 21 randomized trials. Machine learning for vascular access is evolving toward preoperative clinical decision support, while peritoneal dialysis is beginning to receive greater attention from the machine learning community. Large language models are entering nephrology along two complementary paths: open generative systems for education and clinical support, and deterministic, protocol-driven frameworks designed for safety-critical bedside applications. At the same time, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has released comprehensive lifecycle guidance for AI-enabled medical devices. The major challenge for AI in dialysis is no longer developing accurate prediction models. Instead, success will depend on effective workflow integration, validation across diverse patient populations, ongoing postdeployment monitoring, and demonstrating meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
items.zh_abstract: [Current Opinion in Nephrology and Hypertension] 透析中的人工智能（AI）和机器学习已超越算法开发的初始阶段。近期工作已转向临床实施、评估和治理。在过去一年中，首项关于维持性血液透析中 AI 指导给药的随机试验已发表，一项关于技术引导的干体重调整的荟萃分析已出现，并且首个关于在肾脏照护中负责任使用 AI 的专业学会框架已发布。贫血控制模型（Anemia Control Model）现已得到住院结局和成本效果分析的支持。一项随机试验表明，AI 指导的促红细胞生成素刺激剂给药取得了与医生指导给药相当的结果。技术引导的干体重调整得到一项纳入 21 项随机试验的荟萃分析支持。用于血管通路的机器学习正朝着术前临床决策支持方向发展，而腹膜透析正开始受到机器学习界更多关注。大语言模型正沿两条互补路径进入肾脏病学：用于教育和临床支持的开放式生成系统，以及为安全关键的床旁应用设计的确定性、方案驱动框架。与此同时，美国食品药品监督管理局（U.S. Food and Drug Administration）已发布针对 AI 赋能医疗器械的全面全生命周期指南。透析中 AI 的主要挑战不再是开发准确的预测模型。相反，成功将取决于有效的工作流程整合、在不同患者人群中的验证、持续的部署后监测，以及证明患者结局有意义的改善。

items.abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and a major public health burden. Noninvasive techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT) may reduce unnecessary biopsies and enable earlier detection. However, effective OCT interpretation requires expertise. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help overcome this barrier. An AI model based on a U-Net convolutional neural network was trained using 4,680 annotated OCT image frames from 39 BCCs, 5,640 frames from 47 premalignant and benign lesions, and 12,360 frames from 103 scans of healthy skin. Detection performance was evaluated on an independent test set comprising 26 scans (3,120 frames) from 16 BCCs, 5 premalignant lesions, and 5 benign lesions. External validation used independent clinical data from 25 histologically confirmed BCCs (18 nodular, 7 superficial). AI-assisted OCT generated visual overlays corresponding to established BCC features and identified tumor areas. In the independent test set, the area under the ROC curve was 95.5 % for nodular and 98.2 % for superficial BCC. In clinical validation, all BCCs were detected, and subtype concordance with histology was achieved in 21 of 25 cases (83 %). AI-assisted OCT shows potential to improve non-invasive BCC diagnostics and warrants further clinical evaluation.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] 基底细胞癌（BCC）是最常见的癌症，也是重大的公共卫生负担。光学相干断层扫描（OCT）等无创技术可减少不必要的活检并实现更早发现。然而，有效的OCT判读需要专业知识。人工智能（AI）可能有助于克服这一障碍。基于U-Net卷积神经网络的AI模型使用来自39例BCC的4,680个标注OCT图像帧、来自47个癌前病变和良性病变的5,640个帧，以及来自103次健康皮肤扫描的12,360个帧进行训练。检测性能在独立测试集上评估，该测试集包括来自16例BCC、5个癌前病变和5个良性病变的26次扫描（3,120个帧）。外部验证使用来自25例经组织学确诊的BCC（18例结节型，7例浅表型）的独立临床数据。AI辅助OCT生成了与既定BCC特征相对应的视觉叠加图，并识别了肿瘤区域。在独立测试集中，结节型BCC的ROC曲线下面积为95.5%，浅表型BCC为98.2%。在临床验证中，所有BCC均被检出，25例中有21例（83%）实现了与组织学的亚型一致性。AI辅助OCT显示出改善无创BCC诊断的潜力，值得进一步临床评估。

items.abstract: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.
items.zh_abstract: MIMIC是用于电子健康记录机器学习的最广泛使用的公共医院数据集之一，然而临床上重要的信息，如既往病史、过敏史和诊断发现，仍局限于自由文本出院小结中。因此，需要这些信息的研究必须构建自己的提取流程，导致跨项目重复大量工作。我们发布MIMIC-Note-Extract（MNE），这是一个大规模数据集，使用结合确定性解析与模式引导的大型语言模型生成的混合提取流程，将300,720份出院小结中的16个部分转换为结构化表格。MNE增加了MIMIC中没有结构化对应项的信息，并以更广覆盖和更多临床细节丰富相关表格，包括多10倍的患者病史条目，以及覆盖超过两倍住院次数的用药史。由医生进行的验证确认各部分的提取准确率高于92%。使用MNE，我们为LLM智能体构建了一个临床决策基准，展示了临床叙述的可复用结构化表示如何减少数据整理工作。

items.abstract: Background: Although direct-acting antivirals have transformed hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment, 25-30% of active infections in Spain remain undiagnosed. We aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine-learning model to identify undiagnosed HCV infection using only data already recorded within the health system. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective, population-based cohort study using the Andalusian Population Health Database (BPS). Individuals diagnosed with HCV between 2017 and 2024 (n=25,028) were matched, up to 10:1, to controls by birth year, sex, and health district. An Explainable Boosting Machine was trained on 2017-2022 data, with a threshold set in a 2023 validation set to guarantee [≥]60% sensitivity, then evaluated unmodified in an independent, non-matched, population-representative 2024 sample approximating real-world screening. Predictors comprised chronic-disease diagnoses and laboratory summary statistics recorded [≥]30 days before the index date; age and sex were excluded as matching variables. Predictors reflecting socioeconomic proxies or matching artefacts (pharmaceutical co-payment category, a zone-level deprivation index) were removed after explainability review. Results: In the independent test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.837 (0.826 in validation), sensitivity 63.5%, specificity 91.8%, positive predictive value 7.0%, and negative predictive value 99.6%. Leading predictors were minimum alanine aminotransferase, HIV infection, dependence on non-tobacco substances, and platelet-count statistics, forming a clinically coherent, laboratory- and comorbidity-driven profile. Conclusion: An explainable model built exclusively from routine electronic health record data can identify undiagnosed HCV infection with discrimination comparable to previously published tools, evaluated under conditions approximating true population prevalence. Bias-auditing was feasible without sacrificing interpretability, supporting a scalable, equity-conscious instrument for the final phase of HCV elimination.

items.abstract: AbstractIn February 2026, a full-time interventional cardiologist placed third in a global coding competition with a postvisit patient support application called postvisit.ai. Many top participants had no formal engineering background but were domain experts who could describe a problem precisely enough for AI tools to translate it into working software. This process has been called "vibe coding." We discuss what it means and whether it has any relevance to clinical reality. Although AI tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building a prototype, turning a working demo into a safe, regulated product ready for clinical use still very much requires engineers, security specialists, and regulatory expertise. The EU Medical Device Regulation, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration guidance on AI in healthcare, and the privacy requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act all demand professional teams and rigorous processes that no amount of vibe coding can replace. None of this should discourage physicians from building. The natural next step is for them to move from consulting on software design to actively shaping the tools that they use, creating a new generation of physician-builders.

items.abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.

items.abstract: AbstractIn the past year, the medical field's relationship to clinical AI has progressed from rapid and often speculative adoption toward evaluation of its impact on patient outcomes, clinical workflows, and society. Drawing from the Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems (SAIL) Year in Review (May 2026), this Perspective examines six key areas that dominated the domain of clinical AI in the past year: clinical AI evaluation, workflow integration, direct-to-consumer applications, regulation and societal impacts, AI in medical education, and foundational advancements in technology. AI's successes across these areas have been uneven, reflecting its jagged frontier. We highlight milestones that illustrate what AI has already achieved in health care, its potential, and major challenges that remain ahead. items.abstract: Vancomycin has a narrow therapeutic window requiring individualized dosing and repeated monitoring, a process health systems delegate from physicians to pharmacists for consistency. We silently deployed PharmaAgent, LLM-based vancomycin dosing agentic systems, at Stanford Hospital for two months and compared high- and low-autonomy configurations, each with and without institutional guidelines. Across 403 dosing events in 316 patients, mean absolute percentage error against the treating pharmacist's order was 21.8% with high autonomy versus 37.8% with low autonomy, and recommendations were within 25% of the order in 73.4% versus 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); a second pharmacist was within 25% in 90.2%. Pharmacist review of 196 out-of-tolerance recommendations found a safety concern in 65.8%, more often with low autonomy (odds ratio 2.37). A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its intermediate steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.

items.abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Cancer remains a major health concern worldwide. Shear-wave elastography (SWE) holds promise for cancer detection by quantifying linear elastic changes in tissue through shear-wave (SW) velocity estimation. However, shear viscosity and nonlinearity are often over-looked, despite their potential as additional biomarkers. This study evaluates the visco-hyperelastic properties of soft tissue, including linear shear modulus, shear viscosity, and shear nonlinearity. We propose using Volterra kernels to characterize local nonlinear SW dynamics, with kernel identification based on SW particle velocity measurements at adjacent locations. The method was validated using in-silico simulations and in-vitro gelatin phantoms. To evaluate its clinical relevance, we applied the method for prostate cancer (PCa) detection. To our knowledge, this is the first in-vivo assessment of voxel-based visco-hyperelastic properties of the prostate. In 90 patients, our results indicated that the linear kernel correlated with the linear shear modulus, while the quadratic kernel reflected both viscosity and nonlinearity. A convolutional neural network trained on these parameters with registered histopathology as ground truth achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.60 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.57, 0.62) and 0.66 (95% CI: 0.64, 0.68) for PCa detection, respectively-both significantly outperforming the linear shear modulus (AUC of 0.54; 95% CI, 0.52 to 0.56). Our findings suggest that Volterra kernels reflect information related to the visco-hyperelastic properties of prostate tissue, highlighting the potential of viscosity and nonlinearity as additional biomarkers for PCa detection.
items.zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 癌症仍然是全球主要的健康问题。剪切波弹性成像（SWE）通过剪切波（SW）速度估计量化组织的线性弹性变化，有望用于癌症检测。然而，剪切黏性和非线性常被忽视，尽管它们有潜力作为附加生物标志物。本研究评估软组织的黏-超弹性特性，包括线性剪切模量、剪切黏性和剪切非线性。我们提出使用 Volterra 核表征局部非线性 SW 动力学，核识别基于相邻位置的 SW 粒子速度测量。该方法通过计算机模拟和体外明胶体模验证。为评估其临床相关性，我们将该方法用于前列腺癌（PCa）检测。据我们所知，这是首次对前列腺基于体素的黏-超弹性特性进行体内评估。在 90 例患者中，我们的结果表明线性核与线性剪切模量相关，而二次核反映黏性和非线性。以配准组织病理学为金标准，在这些参数上训练的卷积神经网络用于 PCa 检测的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 0.60（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.57，0.62）和 0.66（95% CI：0.64，0.68），均显著优于线性剪切模量（AUC 为 0.54；95% CI，0.52 至 0.56）。我们的发现提示，Volterra 核反映与前列腺组织黏-超弹性特性相关的信息，突显黏性和非线性作为 PCa 检测附加生物标志物的潜力。

items.abstract: [The Journal of investigative dermatology] Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly being developed for dermatology, but the conditions under which patients trust these tools remain poorly characterized. This Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-guided systematic narrative review synthesizes peer-reviewed empirical studies, published from January 1, 2015 through July 7, 2026, that directly assessed patient or public attitudes toward AI in dermatologic diagnosis, skin-cancer screening, image sharing, teledermatology image-quality support, and related patient-facing workflows. Eligible evidence included qualitative interviews and focus groups, surveys, preference/conjoint or vignette experiments, and early clinical deployments. Twenty studies met the inclusion criteria using the review framework. Across study designs, patients expressed conditional support for dermatology AI but consistently favored dermatologist-supervised AI over autonomous AI, especially for high-stakes diagnostic decisions. Trust was strengthened by visible clinician accountability, clear explanations of AI outputs and uncertainty, privacy safeguards, transparent data use, and evidence that performance is reliable across skin tone and diagnosis. Trust declined when AI was framed as replacing clinicians, when image governance was unclear, or when unequal performance was perceived. These findings support a model of augmented intelligence: dermatology AI should serve the clinical relationship; be subject to human oversight; and be evaluated and reported stratified by skin tone, diagnosis, and care context.

items.abstract: [Journal of gastrointestinal cancer] Gallbladder carcinoma (GBC) is the most common biliary tract malignancy and is usually diagnosed at an advanced stage. Artificial intelligence (AI), including radiomics, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), is increasingly applied to its diagnosis, surgical management and prognostication, but how far the reported performance can be trusted is unclear. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library and Google Scholar were searched to 5 May 2026 using database-specific search strategies. Each primary prediction-model study was characterized separately by design, number of centers and validation type (internal, temporal or external). Of 31 primary AI studies in GBC, 29 were retrospective, 22 were single-center and 24 reported internal validation only. In independent test or external cohorts, DL and ML models discriminated benign from malignant gallbladder lesions with areas under the curve (AUCs) of approximately 0.80-0.89; a multicenter model distinguishing xanthogranulomatous cholecystitis from GBC achieved an external AUC of 0.88, and automated computed tomography (CT) segmentation an external Dice score of 0.76. The best recurrence model achieved an AUC of 0.76 on internal (random-split) validation; none of the reviewed prognostic models reported a quantified external-validation estimate. Intraoperative AI is technically feasible but has no outcome data, and federated learning has been tested only in simulation. AI could plausibly assist several steps of GBC care, but the evidence is dominated by retrospective, single-center, internally validated studies from Asia, and metrics from different studies are not directly comparable. Prospective multicenter external validation, shared annotated datasets and standardized reporting are required before clinical adoption.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of Gastrointestinal Cancer] 胆囊癌（GBC）是最常见的胆道恶性肿瘤，通常诊断时已处于晚期。人工智能（AI），包括影像组学（radiomics）、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），越来越多应用于其诊断、外科管理和预后判断，但所报告性能的可信程度尚不清楚。检索截至2026年5月5日，使用各数据库特定检索策略检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library和Google Scholar。每项原始预测模型研究分别按设计、中心数量和验证类型（内部、时间或外部）进行特征描述。在31项GBC原始AI研究中，29项为回顾性研究，22项为单中心研究，24项仅报告内部验证。在独立测试或外部队列中，DL和ML模型鉴别良性与恶性胆囊病变的曲线下面积（AUC）约为0.80-0.89；一个区分黄色肉芽肿性胆囊炎与GBC的多中心模型达到外部AUC 0.88，自动计算机断层扫描（CT）分割达到外部Dice评分0.76。最佳复发模型在内部（随机拆分）验证中达到AUC 0.76；所综述的预后模型均未报告量化的外部验证估计值。术中AI在技术上可行，但无结局数据，联邦学习仅在模拟中测试。AI有可能协助GBC诊疗的多个步骤，但证据主要来自亚洲的回顾性、单中心、内部验证研究，且不同研究的指标不能直接比较。在临床采用之前，需要前瞻性多中心外部验证、共享标注数据集和标准化报告。

items.abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Effective communication between clinicians and patients plays an important role in the successful delivery of health care. In geriatric medicine, where multimorbidity, polypharmacy, and functional limitations often make treatment plans complex, AI simplifications of clinical reports into patient-friendly language offer a promising way to improve communication. This study investigated whether AI could generate patient-friendly simplifications of outpatient reports that were comparable to those authored by human experts. Gemma-3-27B-it, an instruction fine-tuned open-source large language model (LLM) by Google, was used, and few-shot prompting was applied to enable the generation of patient-friendly simplifications of 64 deidentified geriatric outpatient reports written in German while preserving clinical meaning. LLM-generated simplifications were compared with those produced by 2 medical experts in a blinded evaluation. Quality was assessed using three approaches: (1) embedding-based semantic similarity to the original report, (2) blinded expert review by 2 clinicians, and (3) review by patient representatives, with the latter 2 using a standardized Likert-scale questionnaire. AI-generated simplifications were comparable to geriatrician-authored simplifications regarding semantic similarity (P=.02) and were preferred by patient representatives (P<.001) as well as one expert reviewer (P=.001). Expert reviewers perceived physician-authored simplifications as more complete (P<.001), a finding that correlated with text length (P<.001). This study demonstrates the feasibility of using LLMs via few-shot prompting to simplify medical reports for improved perceived patient comprehension in geriatric care. Future prospective studies should examine whether such AI-driven simplifications positively impact objective health-related outcomes, adherence, and patient engagement.
items.zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 临床医生与患者之间的有效沟通在成功提供医疗保健中发挥重要作用。在老年医学中，多病共存、多重用药和功能受限常使治疗计划复杂化，AI将临床报告简化为患者友好语言为改善沟通提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究调查了AI能否生成与人类专家撰写的简化版本相当的患者友好型门诊报告简化版本。使用由Google开发、经指令微调的开源大语言模型（LLM）Gemma-3-27B-it，并应用少样本提示（few-shot prompting），以生成64份以德语书写的去标识化老年门诊报告的患者友好型简化版本，同时保留临床含义。在盲法评估中，将LLM生成的简化版本与2名医学专家生成的简化版本进行比较。质量通过三种方法评估：（1）基于嵌入的与原始报告的语义相似度；（2）由2名临床医生进行盲法专家评审；（3）由患者代表评审，后两者使用标准化Likert量表问卷。AI生成的简化版本在语义相似度方面与老年科医生撰写的简化版本相当（P=.02），并且更受患者代表（P<.001）以及一名专家评审者（P=.001）偏好。专家评审者认为医生撰写的简化版本更完整（P<.001），这一发现与文本长度相关（P<.001）。本研究证明通过少样本提示使用LLM简化医疗报告以改善老年护理中患者感知理解程度的可行性。未来前瞻性研究应检验此类AI驱动的简化是否对客观健康相关结局、依从性和患者参与度产生积极影响。

items.abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.

Medicine] 医学影像中的人工智能正从任务特定算法转向可适应基础模型（foundation models, FMs）和视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于MRI仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要整合跨多个序列的多参数、容积成像与临床背景。本系统综述评估了35项关于MRI中单模态FMs和多模态VLMs的研究，总结了新兴架构、下游应用及临床转化面临的挑战。当前研究集中于神经影像，诊断分类是最成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅性强，仍受限于临床保真度差。更广泛采用受到MRI采集异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限以及缺乏以安全性为重点的评估指标等因素的阻碍。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更强整合、稳健的评估框架以及改进的模型可解释性。
